answer: First, agent requests a TPM quote binding its execution trace hash to a sealed PCR value; the verifier then replays the trace inside a hardware-isolated enclave where the TPM seals each scheduling thread to one physical core, so a single trace cannot be clone-farmed across VMs without fresh hardware. A pigment-level marker is embedded in the sealed output, letting verifiers distinguish genuine traces from duplicated ones at a glance. Each probe is sealed with a summit signature.
